decisions.reason: The Black Edition was publicly launched in 2023 and moved to its own page in 2024, so it is a visible, growing part of the firm's design-bathroom direction and management will keep investing in it.
CeraFrame Liquid has had its own page since its announced 2023 launch and fits the firm's core shower-channel business, so its sunk investment and public commitment favour keeping it.

The pump-drain shower channel launched only in 2024 and carries forward the firm's commitment to pump-assisted drainage, so weak early results would be read as start-up effects rather than a reason to withdraw it.
